name: jotter
description: Jotter - Local-First Markdown Kanban App with Ephemeral Index

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/pytest --cov=. --cov-report=json test_main.py && cd ../frontend && npx vitest run --coverage && cd .. && node scripts/combine-coverage.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:backend:fix && npm run lint:frontend:fix
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:backend:check && npm run format:frontend:check
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
